errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.db_open_failed: The database could not be opened.
errors.migration_failed: The database could not be updated to the new version. Your data was not changed.
errors.db_version_unsupported: The data was created by a newer version of Siyak. Please update the app.
errors.seed_missing: The built-in Quran text is missing. Please reinstall the app.
errors.io_failed: A file could not be read or written.
errors.query_failed: The data could not be loaded.
errors.not_found: The requested item was not found.
errors.invalid_setting_key: The setting could not be saved.
errors.invalid_setting_value: The setting could not be saved.
errors.core_refresh_failed: The Quran text and built-in translations could not be updated to this version's data. The previous data is still in use.
errors.network_failed: Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.host_not_allowed: The connection was blocked because the address is not on Siyak's list of allowed servers.
errors.download_failed: The download failed. Please try again later.
errors.manifest_invalid: The pack list could not be read.
errors.manifest_unsupported: The pack list needs a newer version of Siyak. Please update the app.
errors.manifest_unavailable: The pack list could not be loaded. Check your internet connection.
errors.pack_unsupported: This version of Siyak cannot install this kind of pack.
errors.pack_incompatible: This pack needs a newer version of Siyak. Please update the app.
errors.pack_bundled: This pack ships with the app; it cannot be installed or removed separately.
errors.pack_busy: This pack is already being downloaded or installed.
errors.pack_hash_mismatch: The downloaded file is damaged or has been changed. It was not installed.
errors.pack_too_large: The pack is larger than expected. It was not installed.
errors.pack_invalid: The pack's contents are not valid. It was not installed.
errors.pack_needs_full_data: This pack covers the whole Quran, but the app is running on the small development data. It was not installed. Restart the app without SIYAK_DEV_DATA=dev.
errors.pack_schema_unsupported: This pack was built for a different version of Siyak.
errors.disk_space_insufficient: There is not enough free disk space for this pack.
errors.terms_not_acknowledged: Please read and accept the pack's terms before downloading it.
errors.morphology_replace_required: Installing this morphology pack replaces the one already installed. Please confirm.
errors.backup_invalid: This file is not a Siyak backup.
errors.backup_unsupported: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app and try again.
errors.semantic_unavailable: Semantic search needs a semantic search pack. Install one from Packs.

onboarding.packs_note: Downloads continue in the background; you can manage packs any time from the Packs screen.
